campaign.label: 0.1.0-alpha.11-rc.1
campaign.runtime_kind: local npm candidate installed from tarball
campaign.concurrency_notes: Scaling lanes used CPUs 0/1, fixtures CPU 2, queues CPU 3 and the serial history workflows CPU 4 on one shared VM.

method.storage: fresh Docker-managed native Linux volumes, no network/swap, 512 MiB and 1 vCPU
method.common_deliverables: Persist and reopen the editable recipe, source STEP, exact assembly STEP, mesh preview, indexed version and receipt; rebuild 256 distinct parameter sets. Each output checked in separate OCCT.
method.scope: One uninterrupted session per implementation, four setup deliveries. Colocad also stores native snapshots, full previews and checkpoints. Python controls use SQLite FULL synchronization, fsync, cache advice and bounded live shapes. Current cgroup sampled after commit; peak read before independent verification.
method.flexibility: Two deterministic engineering workflows; three backends each accepted seven deliveries and rejected three incompatible replacements.
